source.from: Written by hand for Glass Cannon. Which effect and skill IDs go with which mechanic came from GT Companion's dungeon warnings (gaming.tools, 0.5.110) as leads; the Ludra raid's from our own runs (2026-11-06, 2026-11-07, 2026-11-13, 2026-11-20) and guides to it (aion2tierlist.com's and dbaion2.ru's: what to do in the grid, Ludra's Trial, and when Rahu splits the arena; Mobalytics' Rahu, Ketu and Ludra guides of 2026-11-09 and MMOPIXEL's Ludra guide, after the 4 November rework: Wheel of Torment's regroup, Ketu's Abyssal Gaze and Eruption of Power, Rahu's Feeding Time, Ludra's opening tail swipe). The dungeon bosses' cast cards marked `source` (Mobalytics' dungeon guides) name moves by the game's own skill names; what to do is from those guides, unconfirmed in our captures. The Corroded Decontamination Facility's (the `cdf.` mechanics; map 620011) are from our own run of 2026-11-28 (a first clear: one fight each with the Surveillance Device, Devouring Klawfly and Black Blood Blatt, seven pulls at Terminator Bargott; docs/research/boss-casts.md), read beside eight guides: GuideMMO's (2026-07-09, with clips of each move), aion2t.com's (2026-04-17, with pictures), Mobalytics' (2026-11-27, the ten-player version), AION2 Codex's, Metaroad's and Aion 2 Timers' (digests of Korean guides), and Metabot's and the fan wiki's pages of game client data (skill names, the 8:00 enrage). A card is there when several guides describe the move the same way and our record has it where they say (its place in the order, its HP threshold, who it hits); `seen` then gives the date. What to do is the guides'. The wording is ours.
source.note: `seen`: the date we confirmed it in our own captures. The rest are unconfirmed leads until a run shows them. `bosses` empty: any boss, for one whose type we may not know (a raid boss up before the meter started).
source.when: effect: a buff or debuff on the boss (on: boss), on you (you), on another player (ally) or on any player (player). cast: the boss casts one of skills; over when it casts one of until (its own skill: when it goes off). stagger: the boss's stagger check (its gauge turns breakable; over once broken or idle). hit: something on the ground hits you.
source.times: max_s: the longest it shows. due_s: when it lands, from its start (a countdown). then: what to do once it's over, for then.s seconds.
source.warn_casts: boss skills always warned about (the cast and its time left), though their cast is short and marks no ground: the ones that killed the most in our runs. 1802730: Isolation Specialist Rahu (his skills are 18026xx to 18029xx; the raid's map is 600082), 17 of 76 deaths in 11 attempts (2026-11-06), a 1.5 s cast. 1801820 (2 s cast) and 1801870 (1.5 s): Abyssal Wings Ketu, 25 and 20 of 197 deaths in 21 attempts (2026-11-07). 1802530 (1.5 s), 1802555 and 1802570 (3 s): the Central Abyss Fusion Reactor, 14 of 20 deaths in our kill (2026-11-07). Eternal Ludra (2026-11-13, 22 attempts, 407 deaths; her casts are 1.5 to 2.3 s, and the damage comes under the cast's ID plus a few, from helper mobs also named Eternal Ludra): 1803200 (2.3 s, 40 deaths in 42 casts), 1803210 (2 s, 40 in 69), 1803160 (1.7 s, 38 in 33), 1803230 (1.5 s, 34 in 25) and 1803250 (1.5 s, 33 in 30). Terminator Bargott (2026-11-28, 7 pulls, 155 deaths): 1803725 (1.8 s, 60 deaths in 23 casts), his three shared slams. His other killers come from helper mobs after casts that have a card of their own below (1803770, 1803860).
source.labels: our own short names for boss skills the game's text only calls "Attack": what the move does, as our runs show it, shown where the boss's cast is named (warnings, timers, the target's cast). Never a name from the game: the game's, or one you give the skill, comes first. Raid-wide: it hit 5 or more of the 10 players on average; area: 2 to 5; else a strike on one. Heavy: half its hits were 30,000 or more (players had about 30,000 HP). Pulses: it hits again and again. Marked ground: the game marks where it lands, seconds ahead. From 22 attempts at Eternal Ludra (2026-11-13) and 23 at Ketu; only moves with 20 or more hits to go by (marked ground goes by the game's marks alone). Sharpened on 2026-11-20 (13 more attempts at Ludra, 12 at Ketu; docs/research/boss-casts.md) by where the players a move hit stood from the boss and by the mobs a cast brings: frontal, side, around her (all round the boss, about 18 m), sweeping (bands of blasts crossing the arena), orbs (falling orbs to catch: blue anyone, red the tank, blocking), line of beams (a row of 14 beams across the arena), two rings (two waves on every side: a guide's reading of them as rings to jump), lightning on every player (a strike on each player, three hits, shared by those within about 4 m: seen on screen, and in the capture a player took 3, 6 or 9 hits by how many stood together). 1801840 and 1801843 are the strikes that open Ketu's weapon smash (the mechanic below), 1801841 and 1801842 its hits on one side of him and then the other; 1801952 is the strike that follows the beams of 1801950. On 2026-11-28 1803240 was named and 1803210 renamed (it was "orbs + blast around her"): 1803240 opens a fixed 37 s script (the mechanic ludra.ludra.closing below; docs/research/boss-casts.md), and the blast that comes with 1803210's orbs is the tornadoes leaving the centre in lanes. 1803230 (it was "raid-wide pulses") is the red circle: seen in the fight, the centre takes a massive hit and the outer floor only small ticks, which are the pulses we counted. Terminator Bargott's (18036xx to 18038xx and 18057xx; 2026-11-28, 7 pulls) go by the order and timing of his casts, which never varied, by who was hit, and by the guides' accounts of each move, which agree with one another and with the order we recorded. 1803660 comes 2.3 s before three hits 2.4 s and 1.45 s apart (1803670, 1803680, 1803690): the guides' three circles, close, wider, then far out with the safe ground close in. 1803770 is his leap to the centre, with a wave to jump (helper hits of 22,000 to 24,000, 1803855, 3.7 to 7.1 s later by how far out a player stood), then 1803820 at +6.0 s, the rain that leaves a puddle under each player (1803840 is the puddle: 7,000 to 9,600 every half second on whoever stands in one, 28 deaths), then at +14.4 s, every time, 1803725: three hits on 9 or 10 players whose size falls as more players take them (16K to 20K each on 7 or 8, 8K to 12K on 9 or 10), the guides' three red markers to share. 1803780 starts his rolls (1803790 the roll's hits, for 5.5 s). 1803860 puts a numbered mark on eight players (effects 12000600 to 12000607, 30 s); 1803780 follows at +6.85 s and seven casts of 1803800 from +10.65 s, 2.4 s apart (eight rolls, one at each number), and at +28.4 s 1803810 or 1803815 hits everyone (6 of the 11 times) or nothing does (5): the bombs he didn't roll over. From 38 to 41 s after the first of those, 1803661 is cast every 7.0 s for the rest of the fight: the Hydraulic Presses falling (1999100 is a press's hit, the mob's own name). 1803776 opens the phase at 50% HP where a target with 8 HP counts down to 0 (the bombs thrown at him). 1805700 is the blinding flash: 2.1 s after it starts about half the raid got a 4.8 s effect (18057053), and 3.2 s after it some 150 instant casts follow (1805707, the orbs). 1805730 puts a 10 s effect (18057301) on 3 to 7 players: the spinning chains. Devouring Klawfly's 1805806 is followed 5.35 s later by a hit of 16K to 19K on everyone (twice in one fight); his 1805840 and Black Blood Blatt's 1804431 and 1804430 each hit for exactly five times the victim's max HP, a kill by design: Klawfly's blast to hide from at 75% and 25%, and Blatt's two colour checks at 72%, which follow 1804568 by 7.9 and 14.5 s.
